title: maint.event.v1{kind=backup_legacy_no_file_manifest}
description: Phase 8 §8.14.2 — emitted during restore-verify when the dump lacks the inner per-file SHA-256 manifest (negelir.files.sha256.txt). Dump was written before §8.14.2 landed. Restore proceeds with outer-checksum-only verification. Severity=info, one-shot per dump.

produced_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this notification was emitted.

dump_date.description: ISO calendar date (UTC) of the dump that lacks an inner per-file manifest.

fallback_action.description: The fallback behaviour taken: outer tarball checksum verified only; no per-file integrity check.

dump_path.description: Path of the dump file or directory relative to the backup root.
